method.notes: Revises Kaplan allocation: model size N and data D should scale EQUALLY with compute; optimum near ~20 tokens/parameter. Most large models were oversized for their data. Loss fits include an explicit irreducible term E. Applied in run2_capacity_diagnosis_and_scaling_review.md: 2.6M params vs ~8.2M unique fixes (~50M fix-visits) is near/above the data-per-parameter optimum, arguing the current WM is not parameter-starved relative to its data — growing N without D moves away from optimum.

gap_analysis.whats_missing: Not a map-matching paper; methodology reference for capacity/data sizing only.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Cited for the equal-scaling result and the irreducible-error term in scaling fits.
